description: Ministry of Labour - T. M. S. L. Priyadarshana Vs. Tea Small Holdings Development Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the revocation and issuance of orders under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically references statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act), amendments to legislation, and the appointment of an arbitrator through legal authority. While it mentions the Minister of Labour by name, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond exercising his statutory powers under the Act, making this a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
